title: On Generalized Quasi-Einstein Manifolds
summary: In this paper, we study generalized $m$-quasi-Einstein $(M^n,g,X,λ)$ under natural conditions on the potential vector field. We show that, under suitable integral assumptions, the potential vector field is Killing, extending earlier results of Sharma to the generalized setting. Moreover, we show that divergence-free vector fields are Killing in this context, and we derive consequences under sign conditions on $m$ and $λ$, including triviality results. We also revisit a recent theorem of Ghosh \cite{ghosh}, discuss a subtle issue in the argument, and provide a new formulation and proof.…
